provider.chipTitle: Which AI answers right now. Click to change.
provider.betterResults: Better results: enable the local AI model or add your own key.

footer.disclaimer: AI can be wrong. Nothing leaves your device unless you add your own key.

desc.heuristics: Fast built-in rules: pattern-based cards, distractors and explanations. Works offline, no download.
desc.chrome-nano: Chrome's built-in model (Gemini Nano) runs on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
desc.webllm: A small language model runs in your browser via WebGPU. Downloaded once, then offline.
desc.byok: Your own API key or proxy is used. Requests go to the vendor you configured.

hub.title: AI tools
hub.subtitle: Turn notes into cards, study guides, practice tests and audio. Private by default.
hub.noSets: You don't have any sets yet. Create one first.
hub.askHint: Ask AI lives on the set page: open a set and tap the “Ask AI ✦” button.

generate.title: Generate flashcards
generate.desc: Paste notes, upload a file or record audio and get an editable set.

studyGuide.title: Study guide
studyGuide.desc: Outline, key terms, summary and practice questions from your material.

practiceTest.title: Practice test
practiceTest.desc: Multiple choice, true/false and written questions from your sets.

listen.title: Listen mode
listen.desc: A spoken podcast of your set with recall pauses. Learn hands-free.

ask.title: Ask AI
ask.desc: A tutor that knows your set: quiz me, mnemonics, key concepts.

source.pastePlaceholder: Put your notes here. We'll do the rest.
source.dropHere: Drop files here or choose a file
source.fileTypes: .txt, .md, .csv, .tsv, .pdf — Word files: copy the text and paste it.
source.fileLoaded: {{count}} file(s) loaded. Check the text in the Paste tab.

fileError.docx: Word/PowerPoint is not supported offline — open the file, select all, copy and paste the text

source.urlHint: Fetching websites only works online and when the site allows it (CORS). Otherwise copy the text and paste it.
source.urlOffline: You are offline. Paste the text instead.
source.urlBlocked: This site cannot be read from the browser. Copy the text from the page and paste it in the Paste tab.
source.urlLoaded: Page text added. Check it in the Paste tab.
source.recordHint: Speech recognition by your browser. The transcript is added to the text; check it afterwards.
source.recordUnsupported: Speech recognition isn't available in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge, or paste your text.

generate.title: Generate flashcards
generate.subtitle: From notes, a file, a web page or a recording to a set in seconds.
generate.none: No cards found. Try notes with “term: definition” lines or definition sentences.

guide.title: Study guide
guide.subtitle: Paste or upload material and get an outline, key terms, a summary and practice questions.
guide.alsoGetDesc: flashcards from the key terms, ready to study.
guide.noCards: No key terms with definitions found to turn into cards.

test.title: Practice test
test.subtitle: Choose sets or paste material to generate practice questions tailored to you.
test.keepGoing: Review the missed ones and try again.
test.none: Not enough material for questions. Add more cards or text.

listen.scriptFailed: The model did not return a usable script.
listen.keys: Space: play/pause · ← →: previous/next card · Esc: close

ask.title: Ask AI
ask.prompt: What study help do you need?
ask.contextHint: I use the set “{{title}}” as context.

settings.intro: AI features always work with built-in rules. For richer results pick a model that runs on your device, or bring your own API key.

providerHint.auto: Uses your key if set, otherwise Chrome AI, otherwise the local model once downloaded, otherwise Basic.
providerHint.heuristics: No model is ever used. Fastest and fully private.
providerHint.chrome-nano: Requires Chrome with the built-in model available.
providerHint.webllm: Requires WebGPU and a one-time download.
providerHint.byok: Requires an API key or a proxy URL below.

nano.title: Chrome built-in AI
nano.desc: Gemini Nano inside Chrome. Free, on-device, no setup besides the one-time download by Chrome.
nano.unavailable: Not available in this browser. Chrome 138+ on desktop with 22 GB free disk space is required.

webllm.title: Local model (WebLLM)
webllm.desc: A small open model runs in your browser via WebGPU. Downloaded once from Hugging Face and cached; afterwards it works offline.
webllm.noWebgpu: WebGPU is not available in this browser, so the local model cannot run here.
webllm.consentHint: About {{size}} MB over your connection. Nothing is uploaded.

byok.title: Your own API key
byok.desc: Use a key from a vendor you trust. The key is stored only in this browser and sent only to that vendor.

proxy.title: Proxy URL (optional)
proxy.hint: URL of your own Cloudflare Worker that adds the key server-side (see extras/cloudflare-worker). Leave empty to call the vendor directly.

settings.privacy: Privacy: with Basic, Chrome AI or the local model nothing leaves your device. With your own key, your texts are sent to that vendor under their terms.
settings.heuristicsNote: Basic mode is always available as a fallback, even when a model fails or is offline.

tts.unsupported: Text-to-speech is not available in this browser.
tts.enableHint: Speaker buttons on cards and Listen mode use your browser's voices.
tts.noVoices: No voice installed for this language. Add one in your system settings.
